transcript.text: let's understand HTTP status codes HTTP
or hypertext transfer protocol is used
for communication between client and a
server on the internet when you make an
API call the response returns a
three-digit status code which helps us
understand the outcome of the request
status codes in 1xx range are
informational and indicate that the
request has been received and the
process is continuing status codes in
2xx range are successful and it means
that the request has been received
understood and accepted status code with
3xx range means redirection this is
usually because the requested resource
has moved to a different URL status code
in 4xx range indicates an issue with the
client's request such as invalid request
or unauthorized access and lastly status
code with 5xx range indicates the server
issue where a server failed to fulfill a
valid request due to internal issues
